description: Agent Governance: submit the pre-purchase terms between an agent’s operator and a seller or platform: when liability for agent error is agreed, who pays when the agent errs and per error case, the liability cap, the dispute path (forum, decider and window), what standing the payment record has between the parties, and every way a purchase can proceed. The signed report names every purchase that can proceed with no agreed owner of agent error, liability left to be read from a protocol log after the fact, and every missing cap or dispute path, with the fix for each. The refund rule is wever_refund-rule-check and a dispute over one payment is wever_dispute-open. Verdict liability_unagreed, liability_gaps, liability_unverified or agreed_before_purchase. POST /api/liability-terms-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-governance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-governance/.
